question.instructions: Which ONE of these optional capabilities, if any, would MATERIALLY help with THIS prompt? Pick 'none' unless one clearly applies — do not reach.

criteria.none: No listed capability would materially help with this prompt.
criteria.agent-reach: The prompt pastes or names a social/video/forum link (YouTube, Reddit, X/Twitter, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, GitHub, LinkedIn, V2EX, Instagram) or asks to read, search, scrape, or get subtitles/comments/quotes from one, and the agent's own web tools cannot.
criteria.lemo-opuscar: The prompt asks to explain, visualize, teach, or animate how code, an algorithm, or a data structure works as a video, film, or animation.
criteria.skill-inspector: The prompt is about installing, adding, cloning, enabling, or trusting a downloaded skill or plugin, or asks whether a skill/plugin is safe, over-permissioned, or malicious.
criteria.freellmapi: The prompt mentions hitting LLM rate limits, HTTP 429s, quota or credit exhaustion, model overload, or wanting free or pooled model providers behind one endpoint.
criteria.pentagi: The prompt asks to run an authorized penetration test, vulnerability scan, exploit, or offensive security assessment against a target the operator owns or has written permission to test.
